title: Vikram and Betal: The Grateful Boy

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a boy who forgets gratitude.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a boy who never said thank you.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The boy got lost in the forest.
scenes.image_prompt: boy looking lost in forest cartoon

scenes.text: A kind man helped him find his way home.
scenes.image_prompt: man guiding boy through forest cartoon

scenes.text: The boy thanked the man and learned an important lesson.
scenes.image_prompt: boy thanking man with smile cartoon

scenes.text: The boy became grateful. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.

story: A boy learned to be thankful after being helped when lost. Vikram said gratitude is important.
